name: High Sorcerer Andromath
label: Quest
description: At Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum, a summons calls promising Alliance mages to the tower's summit. Andromath works among the kingdom's foremost archmages…
intro: At Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum, a summons calls promising Alliance mages to the tower's summit. Andromath works among the kingdom's foremost archmages beyond ruined Dalaran.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, friend. He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.
It would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in Dalaran. Council with him is high council indeed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, friend. I am pleased to see you, and hope you have time to listen to an old man's words...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
